fields.statement: At 9a3773fa on Linux, built the binary (go build -trimpath) and ran it as a real daemon in a scratch git repo with rhiza init: sh started two 'sleep 3' children, wrote the first one's pid to .git/rhiza/drivers, then exec'd into 'rhiza daemon --min-free 0 --permission-mode acceptEdits', the same pid, as a re-exec does. After 3 s, ps showed both sleeps as zombies (Z) whose ppid was the daemon. The listed one disappeared on the daemon's next loop pass, at about 72 s, because the first poll is slow here (its usage scan of ~/.claude transcripts predates this change). The list file was then removed. The unlisted sleep stayed a zombie of the daemon until the daemon stopped, so the reaper waits only on listed pids and never calls wait4(-1). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestReap: ok. Not exercised: stale entries left by a different daemon, which the code cannot tell apart (see the qa finding).
